ai.title: Insilico Medicine Receives FDA Fast Track Designation for ISM6331, the AI-driven Pan-TEAD Inhibitor, in Advanced Mesothelioma
ai.description: FDA Fast Track Designation (FTD) aims to accelerate the review process of high-value assets, and ISM6331 marks Insilico's first FTD, recognizing the clinical potential in advanced mesothelioma.ISM6331 is a novel, potential best-in-class, pan-TEAD inhibitor engineered via Chemistry42 to restore Hippo pathway balance, and its Phase I first-in-human data has been accepted for a brief oral presentation at ESMO 2026.The FTD grants ISM6331 enhanced FDA engagement to accelerate the clinical development processes, alongside eligibility for Rolling Review, Accelerated Approval, and Priority Review, if relevant criteria are met.CAMBRIDGE, Mass., July 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Insilico Medicine ('Insilico'; HKEX: 3696), a clinical-stage generative artificial intelligence (AI)-driven drug discovery company, today announced that ISM6331, a novel, potential best-in-class pan-TEAD inhibitor driven by Insilico's proprietary AI, has received Fast Track Designation (FTD) from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable malignant pleural mesothelioma whose disease has progressed on or after prior treatment with anti-PD-1 antibody therapy, with or without anti-CTLA-4 antibody therapy, and platinum-based chemotherapy.
ai.title_cn: Insilico Medicine因AI驱动的泛TEAD抑制剂ISM6331在晚期间皮瘤治疗中获得FDA快速通道认证
ai.description_cn: FDA快速通道指定（GPT）旨在加速高价值资产的审查过程，而ISM 6331标志着Insilico的第一个MTD，认识到晚期间皮瘤的临床潜力。ISM 6331是一种新型、潜在的同类最佳泛TEAD抑制剂，通过Chemistry 42工程设计，旨在恢复Hippo途径平衡，其第一阶段首次人体数据已被接受，在ESCO 2026上进行简短的口头演示。FLEX授权ISM 6331加强FDA参与度，以加速临床开发流程，并获得滚动审查、加速批准、如果满足相关标准，并进行优先审查。马萨诸塞州剑桥，2026年7月29日/美通社/ -- Insilico Medicine（“Insilico”;香港交易所：3696）是一家临床阶段生成人工智能（AI）驱动的药物发现公司，今天宣布，由Insilico专有人工智能驱动的新型、潜在的同类最佳泛TEAD抑制剂ISM 6331已获得美国食品和药物管理局（FDA）的快速通道指定（GPT），用于治疗患有不可切除的恶性胸腔间皮瘤的成年患者，其疾病在既往接受抗PD-1抗体治疗、联合或不联合抗CTLA-4抗体治疗和铂类化疗期间或之后已进展。
